typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{First Name } as string,
		{Last Name } as string,
		{Company Name } as string,
		{Credential Company Name} as string,
		{Card number} as decimal(18,0),
		Disabled as string,
		{Clearance name} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CardNumber as integer,
		ClearanceName as string,
		CompanyName as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		CredentialCompanyName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		LastName as string,
		Disabled as string,
		FName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CardNumber = {Card number},
		ClearanceName = {Clearance name},
		CompanyName = {Company Name },
		UploadDate,
		EtlUser,
		CredentialCompanyName = {Credential Company Name},
		FirstName = {First Name },
		LastName = {Last Name },
		Disabled,
		FName),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
